Query predictions for analysis

Source: R/database.R
query_predictions.Rd

Query predictions for analysis

Usage

query_predictions(
  con,
  model_name = NULL,
  from_date = NULL,
  to_date = NULL,
  only_settled = TRUE
)

Arguments

con

A DBI connection.

model_name

Character. Filter by model (optional).

from_date

Date. Filter predictions from this date (optional).

to_date

Date. Filter predictions to this date (optional).

only_settled

Logical. Only return predictions with outcomes (default TRUE).

Value

A tibble of predictions.

See also

Other storage: connect_db(), create_predictions_schema(), create_schema(), disconnect_db(), insert_match_odds(), insert_matches(), insert_transfers(), log_prediction(), log_predictions_batch(), update_prediction_outcome(), write_matches_parquet(), write_odds_parquet()
